title: HURREVAC and RtePM - Operations and Maintenance (O and M)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTH ATLANTIC.ENDIST BALTIMORE.W2SD ENDIST BALTIMORE
detail_text: This is an operations, maintenance, and development of HURREVAC (HURRicane EVACuation) program and its sub-component (i.e., Real Time Evacuation Planning Model RteP]). This will be a Firm Fixed Price Contract with a three (3) year period of performance. Solicitation will be posted to SAM.gov on or about 15 April 2026 at 1300 est.
